name: Pippy's Ultimate Quest for Friendship (and Lessons)!!!
source:
As Pippy the annoying cliché hyperenergetic rabbit, working at a maid cafe, at the age of 11, in a world where there is no more school, your goal is to make as many friends as you can (unless you don't want to, that is).

Will Pippy get enough friends to be satisfied?

[From [url=https://mintglow.itch.io/puqffal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演皮皮，一只让人头疼、精力过剩又满是老套设定的兔子。她今年11岁，在一个已经没有学校的世界里，于女仆咖啡馆工作。你的目标，是尽可能多地交朋友——除非你根本不想这么做。

皮皮能交到足够多的朋友，心满意足吗？

[摘自[url=https://mintglow.itch.io/puqffal]Itch.io[/url]]
